# Wheelr

> Wheelr is a free online wheel spinner and random picker. You add names, prizes or
> options, spin the wheel, and it selects one at random. It is used for raffles,
> giveaways, classroom picks, live-stream draws, team decisions and yes/no questions.
> It runs in any browser with no account and no installation, and there is also a free
> Android app.

Key facts:

- Website: https://www.wheelr.xyz/
- Price: free. No signup, no credit card, no paywalled features. Funded by donations and by ads inside the Android app only.
- Platforms: any modern web browser (desktop and mobile) plus a free Android app (package `xyz.wheelr.app`).
- Account: optional. Without an account everything stays on the device; signing in syncs wheels across devices.
- Capacity: up to 4 wheels can be configured and shown at the same time.
- Views: classic wheel, linear (slot-style) and cards.
- Sharing: any wheel can be published as a read-only public link.
- Randomness: the spin uses the browser's cryptographic random source, so results are not seeded or predictable.
- Author: AnnyoneAny (https://x.com/AnnyoneAny). Source: https://github.com/annyoneany-crypto/Wheelr

## Pages

- [Wheel app](https://www.wheelr.xyz/): the spinner itself — add entries, customize, spin. Also available as markdown at /md/index.md
- [Guide and use cases](https://www.wheelr.xyz/info): step-by-step instructions, real-life examples, social-media scenarios and FAQ. Markdown: /md/info.md
- [Templates](https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates): ready-made wheels (Yes or No, Prize Giveaway, Team Picker, Truth or Dare, Discount Wheel, and more). Markdown: /md/templates.md
- [Privacy policy](https://www.wheelr.xyz/privacy): what is collected on the web and in the Android app, GDPR basis, data deletion. Markdown: /md/privacy.md
- [Support the project](https://www.wheelr.xyz/donation): donation options that keep Wheelr free. Markdown: /md/donation.md
